Systems Architecture: You understand tensor operations, memory bottlenecks, and how matrix multiplication actually maps to the hardware. Distributed Topologies: You can design for P2P mesh networks, parallel processing, and asynchronous consensus across high-latency, unreliable nodes. The Reality: Location: 100% Remote, anywhere on the planet. Compensation: This is an equity-only, ground-floor position. We are building foundational infrastructure. If you want to build the engine that everyone else will eventually run their models on, let's talk.
